batches.name: Brandywine Hundred: Holy Child, St. Helena, Holy Rosary, IHM
batches.why: Four Brandywine Hundred Deanery parishes in north Wilmington and Claymont. One pastor for Holy Child and St. Helena since 14 January 2026 (thedialog.org clergy appointments, 2025-12-01), with a shared associate: check whether they now print one bulletin or two. Holy Child and IHM embed LPi ids; Holy Rosary has a Spanish Mass. GCatholic's Plus Code for Holy Child (gcatholic:19321) is on Holy Family, Newark: use the directory pin or OSM.

batches.name: St. Ann and St. Thomas the Apostle, with St. Mary Magdalen and St. Joseph on the Brandywine
batches.why: St. Ann and St. Thomas the Apostle (Wilmington) have one pastor since April 2026 (thedialog.org clergy appointments, 2026-04-27) and sainttom.org links stannwilmington.com/bulletins (probe 2026-10-27): the likeliest shared bulletin in the north. St. Mary Magdalen was administered by St. Thomas's pastor from October 2025 to April 2026, and St. Ann by St. Joseph on the Brandywine's pastor from July 2025; check that each now prints its own.

batches.name: New Castle and Delaware City
batches.why: Holy Spirit and St. Peter the Apostle share one website (sphsnc.org, which the directory gives both) and one ParishesOnline org (holy-spirit-st-peter-the-apostle): probably one bulletin, settle it. Our Lady of Fatima (church-bulletin.org id 304, John Patrick Publishing) and St. Paul, Delaware City (self-hosted /bulletins/) look separate. GCatholic still gives older domains: holyspiritchurchde.org (alive, no bulletin found on 2026-10-27), stpetertheapostlede.org (no DNS), stpaulsrcchurch.org (HTTP 5xx).

batches.name: St. Matthew with Corpus Christi; St. John the Beloved with St. Catherine of Siena
batches.why: Two pairs that share clergy (thedialog.org clergy appointments): St. Matthew and Corpus Christi share an associate since December 2025, and the directory gives Corpus Christi St. Matthew's website (stmatthewsde.com); St. John the Beloved and St. Catherine of Siena share a pastor since September 2025. St. Matthew's bulletin page embeds the ParishesOnline org st-matthew-parish-and-corpus-christi (browser, 2026-10-27): probably one bulletin for both; read the masthead. Corpus Christi is 'Elsmere' on GCatholic and the deaneries page, 'Wilmington' in the directory; GCatholic's Corpus Christi Plus Code (gcatholic:19322) is on Holy Child, Naamans Rd. GCatholic's saintmatthewsparish.org and ccparishwilmington.org are old domains.

batches.name: Newark, Pike Creek and Hockessin
batches.why: Holy Family (Newark) and Resurrection (Pike Creek) shared an associate from June 2024 (thedialog.org clergy appointments, 2024-05-19): check for a shared bulletin. St. John the Baptist (GCatholic: 'St. John the Baptist–Holy Angels', one building), St. Margaret of Scotland (eCatholic, also a jppc.net John Patrick listing) and St. Mary of the Assumption, Hockessin (Brandywine Hundred Deanery; directory site smachurch.com, GCatholic's old stmaryoftheassumption.com) look separate. GCatholic's Holy Family Plus Code (gcatholic:19323) is on Corpus Christi, Elsmere. Five parishes, all expected single.

batches.name: Wilmington west side: St. Anthony, St. Paul, St. Elizabeth, St. Hedwig
batches.why: Four City Deanery parishes west of downtown, each with its own site: St. Anthony of Padua (sapde.org; stanthonynet.org redirects there), St. Paul (eCatholic, Spanish Masses), St. Elizabeth (eCatholic) and St. Hedwig (Polish Mass). No shared pastor named in the 2024–2026 appointments.

batches.name: Downtown Catholic (Cathedral, St. Mary, St. Patrick), St. Joseph on French St., Christ Our King
batches.why: downtowncatholic.com (2026-10-27): 'The Downtown Catholic Churches are individual parishes administered by the one pastoral team. Though we worship in three churches' (Cathedral of St. Peter, St. Mary of the Immaculate Conception, St. Patrick), with one Bulletin page: probably one row. The bishop's deanery realignment (Dialog, 2026-03-26) lists the City Deanery without St. Mary and St. Patrick, but cdow.org/deaneries (modified 2026-05-26) still lists both: find out what changed. smspwilmington.com (GCatholic's site for both) now redirects to a web-design firm; the Downtown Catholic bulletin page links jppc.net/onlinebulletins/309 (John Patrick Publishing). St. Joseph (French St.) is separate from Downtown Catholic. Christ Our King (GCatholic only) 'closed in November 2016' and is now a funeral home (Dialog, 2020-07-30). The cathedral is not on GCatholic.

batches.name: Immaculate Conception, Elkton with St. Jude; St. Thomas More Oratory; Our Lady of the Highways
batches.why: One pastor for Immaculate Conception, Elkton and St. Thomas More Oratory (the University of Delaware Newman Center, Newark) since 2024 (thedialog.org clergy appointments, 2024-05-19): check for a shared bulletin, though a campus oratory likely prints its own or none. St. Jude, North East is 'mission of Immaculate Conception' (summer guide). Our Lady of the Highways, Childs (GCatholic only, a shrine): find whether it has public Mass and whose bulletin lists it.

batches.name: Good Shepherd, Perryville and its churches
batches.why: One parish, four churches: GCatholic and the directory give Good Shepherd, Perryville's site (goodshepherdcecilmd.org, eCatholic, with a FATA Online bulletin link) for St. Agnes, Rising Sun, St. Teresa, Port Deposit and St. Patrick, Conowingo too. Check which churches the bulletin's schedule covers (St. Patrick: a Saturday-morning chapel, own old domain stpatschapel.org unreachable).

batches.name: St. Joseph, Middletown with its missions; St. Elizabeth Ann Seton, Bear
batches.why: St. Joseph, Middletown has St. Rose of Lima, Chesapeake City ('mission of St. Joseph, Middletown, DE', summer guide) and the St. Francis Xavier Shrine (Old Bohemia), Warwick, which reopens on 6 December 2026 after renovation, then Mass 'once a month between April and December on the first Sunday at 2 p.m.' (Dialog, 2026-09-02). GCatholic also keeps St. Joseph's former church at 15 W Cochran St. (gcatholic:57105): find whether it holds Mass. St. Elizabeth Ann Seton, Bear (eCatholic) is a separate parish. The directory's Middletown website is a catholicmasses.org listing; stjosephmiddletown.com answers 4xx to probe url but opens in the browser and links jppc.net/onlinebulletins/319.

batches.name: St. Polycarp with St. Dennis; Sacred Heart, Chestertown with St. John, Rock Hall
batches.why: St. Polycarp, Smyrna and St. Dennis, Galena have one pastor (thedialog.org clergy appointments, 2024-05-19: 'reappointed Pastor of Saint Dennis, Galena. This is in addition to his appointment as Pastor of Saint Polycarp'): check for a shared bulletin. Sacred Heart, Chestertown (eCatholic) with St. John the Evangelist, Rock Hall ('mission of Sacred Heart', summer guide). St. Dennis has a church-bulletin.org listing (id 732).

batches.name: Holy Cross, Dover with Immaculate Conception, Marydel; St. John, Milford with St. Bernadette
batches.why: Holy Cross, Dover and Immaculate Conception, Marydel have shared associates since 2024 (thedialog.org clergy appointments, 2024-11-26, 2025-04-17): check for a shared bulletin. Holy Cross's directory link is a spam page (sub.ireland724.info) and its old domain holycrossnet.org has no DNS; that spam page embeds discovermass:holy-cross-dover-de, a lead. St. John the Apostle, Milford and St. Bernadette, Harrington share GCatholic's dead site stjohn-stbernadette.org and the directory's stjohnsmilford.com (Wix, a bulletin PDF on the home page): likely one bulletin. IC Marydel posts its own on iccmarydel.org/bulletin.

batches.name: Our Mother of Sorrows with St. Peter; St. Christopher, Kent Island; St. Benedict with St. Elizabeth
batches.why: Our Mother of Sorrows, Centreville with St. Peter the Apostle, Queenstown ('mission of Our Mother of Sorrows', 'Reopening July 4, 2026 following renovation', summer guide; one ParishesOnline org our-mother-of-sorrows-st-peter-the-apostle; the directory lists no Mass for St. Peter). St. Benedict, Ridgely and St. Elizabeth of Hungary, Denton share beparish.com (eCatholic). St. Benedict's pastor administered St. Christopher, Chester from November 2025 until its own pastor in April 2026 (thedialog.org clergy appointments): check St. Christopher prints its own (eCatholic 17976).

batches.name: Sts. Peter and Paul, Easton with its missions; St. Mary, Cambridge with Church Creek; Secretary
batches.why: Three parishes, six churches. Sts. Peter and Paul, Easton with St. Michael, St. Michaels and St. Joseph, Cordova (both 'mission of Saints Peter & Paul', summer guide; the directory gives Cordova a ssppparisheaston.org page). St. Mary Refuge of Sinners, Cambridge with St. Mary Star of the Sea, Church Creek (the Tubman Chapel; Sunday 9 AM 'Memorial Day weekend through late September'). Our Lady of Good Counsel, Secretary looks separate. GCatholic's stmaryscambridge.org has no DNS; the directory's Cambridge link is a catholicmasses.org listing, but it gives Church Creek stmarycambridgemd.org.

batches.name: Delaware beaches: St. Edmond, St. Jude, St. Ann with Our Lady of Guadalupe
batches.why: St. Ann, Bethany Beach and Our Lady of Guadalupe, Frankford share stannbb.org (directory) and GCatholic's stannsbethany.org: likely one bulletin. St. Edmond, Rehoboth has two summer-only Mass sites in the summer guide (Parish Hall; Rehoboth Elementary School), entries of their own here: settle them under the seasonal-site rule. St. Jude, Lewes (stjudelewes.org; GCatholic's stjudeslewesde.org now redirects to an unrelated site). Our Lady of Guadalupe's directory pin and GCatholic's are about 24 km apart: check the building.

batches.name: St. Michael, Georgetown with Mary, Mother of Peace; Our Lady of Lourdes, Seaford
batches.why: The deaneries page names one parish 'Saint Michael the Archangel/Mary Mother of Peace, Georgetown', and both churches share smammop.com: likely one bulletin. Our Lady of Lourdes, Seaford (GoDaddy site, 'weekly-bulletin-1' page) looks separate. Heavy Spanish-language schedules at Georgetown and Seaford.

batches.name: St. Francis de Sales, Salisbury with Holy Redeemer, Delmar; Holy Name, Pocomoke with St. Elizabeth, Westover
batches.why: Two parishes with a mission each. The directory names the first parish 'St Francis de Sales & Holy Redeemer parish' and lists St. Francis de Sales twice (directory:184 at 413 Wicomico St with no Masses, directory:175 at 535 Riverside Dr): one church, or a second site? Holy Redeemer is 'mission of St. Francis de Sales' (summer guide; Korean Masses 2nd and 4th Saturday). Holy Name of Jesus, Pocomoke City and St. Elizabeth, Westover share hnjpocomoke.org (no bulletin found by probe url or the browser on 2026-10-27). visitstfrancis.org was unreachable on 2026-10-27.

batches.name: Ocean City and Ocean Pines: St. Luke with St. Andrew; St. Mary Star of the Sea with Holy Savior; St. John Neumann
batches.why: St. Luke with St. Andrew ('seasonal mission of St. Luke – open May 23 – Sept. 6', summer guide; both on stlukeoc.com). St. Mary Star of the Sea and Holy Savior are one parish ('St. Mary & Holy Savior Parish', directory; stmarystaroftheseaocmd.com redirects to stmaryholysavior.com): St. Mary's Sunday Mass is 'Memorial Day – Labor Day' and Holy Savior's summer schedule begins Memorial Day weekend, so check the off-season schedule of both. St. John Neumann, Berlin (Ocean Pines; weconnect site; the directory links a catholicindex.org listing).

batches.name: Ukrainian Catholic churches and the Dover AFB chapel
batches.why: Not parishes of the diocese: St. Nicholas, Wilmington and St. Basil the Great, Chesapeake City are Ukrainian Catholic (GCatholic marks both 'Ukrainian'; Archeparchy of Philadelphia), and Our Lady of Perpetual Help, Dover AFB is the base chapel (436th Airlift Wing chaplaincy; Archdiocese for the Military Services). The directory lists all three. Expect `other-jurisdiction` exclusions; confirm each jurisdiction from a source.
